prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime illustration of a terrified blonde high-school girl with twin ponytails, blue eyes, navy blazer, white shirt, red bow tie, plaid skirt, and black knee socks trapped inside a modern glass elevator at night. She is sitting on the elevator floor in the lower center, knees pulled together, hands clamped over her ears, mouth open screaming, tears streaming down her flushed face, with a small blue hairpin near her bangs and dark ribbon bows in her ponytails. The elevator has reflective dark metal walls, a handrail on the left, a floor-number control panel on the right, and a glowing red emergency light above the panel. Behind her, the elevator’s full-height glass doors reveal a dense neon city skyline at night with many lit windows and a tall red-and-blue illuminated tower in the distance. A huge layered paper-like hornet nest protrudes from the upper left wall, textured with overlapping gray-beige ridges. Fill the elevator with exactly 39 visible giant hornets/wasps with black-and-yellow striped bodies and translucent wings: 1 huge close-up hornet blurred at the bottom left foreground, 1 huge close-up hornet blurred at the bottom right foreground, 1 large hornet at the upper right near the emergency light, 1 large hornet mid-right beside the control panel, 1 large hornet lower right edge, 1 large hornet lower left edge, 1 large hornet on the nest surface, 2 hornets clinging near the nest opening, 3 hornets crawling along the left nest rim, 4 hornets flying across the top ceiling area, 5 hornets scattered against the city window, 6 hornets around the girl’s shoulders and sides, 5 hornets near the floor in front of her knees, 4 hornets along the right wall and panel area, and 4 partially cropped hornets at the frame edges. Use cinematic low-angle perspective, intense claustrophobic composition, glossy reflections on the elevator floor, shallow depth of field with some foreground insects motion-blurred, high-detail anime rendering, moody blue-black nighttime lighting contrasted with red emergency glow and neon city colors. Make the emotion extreme and readable: panic, crying, helplessness, and overwhelming swarm danger. No captions, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptZh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖屏动漫插画，画面中一名惊恐的 金发双马尾女高中生，蓝色眼睛，身穿海军蓝西装外套、白衬衫、红领结、格子裙和黑色过膝袜 被困在夜晚的现代玻璃电梯内。她坐在电梯地板的下方中央，双膝并拢，双手紧紧捂住耳朵，张嘴尖叫，泪水顺着涨红的脸庞流下，刘海旁别着一个小蓝发夹，双马尾上系着深色蝴蝶结。电梯拥有反光的深色金属墙壁，左侧设有扶手，右侧有楼层控制面板，面板上方亮着红色的应急灯。在她身后，电梯的全高玻璃门外展现出夜晚密集的霓虹城市天际线，可以看到许多亮灯的窗户，远处还有一座红蓝交织的照明塔。一个巨大的层叠纸质蜂巢从左上方的墙壁凸出，呈现出重叠的灰米色纹理。在电梯内填入正好 39 只清晰可见的巨型黄蜂/胡蜂，它们拥有黑黄相间的条纹身体和半透明翅膀：左下方前景处有 1 只巨大的模糊特写黄蜂，右下方前景处有 1 只巨大的模糊特写黄蜂，应急灯附近的右上角有 1 只大型黄蜂，控制面板旁的中右侧有 1 只大型黄蜂，右下边缘有 1 只大型黄蜂，左下边缘有 1 只大型黄蜂，蜂巢表面有 1 只大型黄蜂，蜂巢开口附近附着 2 只黄蜂，左侧蜂巢边缘爬行着 3 只黄蜂，顶部天花板区域有 4 只黄蜂飞过，城市窗户背景处散布着 5 只黄蜂，少女肩部和身体两侧环绕着 6 只黄蜂，她膝盖前的地板附近有 5 只黄蜂，右侧墙壁和面板区域有 4 只黄蜂，画面边缘还有 4 只被部分裁剪的黄蜂。采用电影级的低角度透视，强烈的幽闭恐惧构图，电梯地板上有光亮的反射，浅景深效果使部分前景昆虫产生动态模糊，高细节动漫渲染，冷调的蓝黑色夜间光影与红色应急灯及霓虹城市色彩形成对比。展现出极度且清晰可见的情绪：恐慌、哭泣、无助以及被蜂群包围的绝望感。无字幕，无水印，无额外字符。
